per_host.method: Two distinct sub-cases. (1) GridScan.tsx/.jsx: face-api.js tiny-model weights (tinyFaceDetector + faceLandmark68Tiny, manifest + 1 shard each, ~280KB total) downloaded to assets/face-api-weights/ and the `modelsPath` default rewritten. Vite's dev server ran the extension-less shard files through its JS import-analysis transform (500 error) instead of serving them as static binaries, so they were renamed with a `.bin` extension and each manifest's `paths` array updated to match. (2) persona.tsx: the jsdelivr URL is not a literal string in this file at all -- it's a hardcoded default inside the @rive-app/webgl2 library's RuntimeLoader (rive_fallback.wasm). Added @rive-app/webgl2@2.39.2 as an explicit _verify dependency and called the library's own RuntimeLoader.setWasmUrl()/setWasmFallbackUrl() override API at module load, pointing at wasm files vendored from the same package version (also closes the related unpkg.com case, see below).
per_host.notes: Verified in-browser for GridScan.tsx/.jsx: 0 external requests, clean render. persona.tsx: request log confirms only local /assets/unpkg.com/rive.wasm and the local .riv model are requested (0 external hosts) -- the network fix is confirmed. However, full end-to-end render verification could not be completed in this sandbox: the harness's headless Chromium (software rendering via swiftshader, --no-sandbox) crashes ~50-55s into initializing the WebGL2 canvas once the wasm actually loads and initializes (previously this never happened because the network call failed instantly). This looks like a resource-constrained sandbox limitation, not a defect introduced by the fix -- documented honestly rather than claimed as a clean pass.

per_host.method: ModelViewer.tsx/.jsx use drei's <Environment preset=...>. Verified in-browser that passing a `path` prop alongside `preset` does NOT work -- drei's useEnvironment unconditionally overwrites `path` with its own CUBEMAP_ROOT (raw.githack.com) whenever `preset` is set. Fixed by replicating drei's internal preset->filename table (a local HDRI_FILES const) and switching to `<Environment files={HDRI_FILES[preset]} path=.../>`, which bypasses drei's preset special-case entirely. All 8 presets in this component's environmentPreset union (apartment, city, dawn, forest, night, park, studio, sunset) were downloaded to assets/raw.githack.com/hdri/, not just the 'forest' default -- so every value the dropdown offers works offline, not only the one the automated check happened to sample.
